outcome: source-defined human BSEP vesicle inhibition, IC50 <50 micromolar; positive=1
scores: saved uncalibrated auxiliary scores; not validated probabilities
scaffold_source: original cached fold_group/scaffold audit; no new RDKit generation
cohorts: E172 is nested within E201; no independent replication claim

bootstrap.sampling: with replacement within each observed outcome class and stratum
bootstrap.paired: same draws for real and permutation-trained scores

not_propagated: uncertainty in unseen types of positive molecule

comparisons: No between-stratum hypothesis tests or equivalence claims; primary cohort unchanged
verification: overall point estimates match original AP/AUC to 1e-12; weighted implementation checked against sklearn for original and three bootstrap draws per route/stratum
